description: Dice and Respawn Entertainment are working on a new Star Wars: Battlefront title. According to a report, the two studios are collaborating on Star Wars: Battlefront 3. EA has not confirmed the game yet, but it said this week that the two studios were working together on a new shooter title. EA announced a new round of layoffs this week
title: Star Wars: Battlefront 3 Reportedly in the Works at EA's Respawn and Dice Studios

description: WhatsApp is testing a new Instagram Reels shortcut in the chat attachment menu for Android users. The feature lets users browse their recently watched, saved and liked Reels and share them directly in chats, without having to look for them in the media picker. It is rolling out to some beta testers running WhatsApp beta for Android version 2.26.42.9. Users must link their WhatsApp account to Accounts Centre to access the shortcut, while a wider rollout remains unconfirmed.
title: WhatsApp Reels Shortcut for Chats Rolling Out to Android Beta Testers

description: Amazon's Great Indian Festival 2026 is offering some amazing offers on Intel powered AI PCs. The offers to watch: up to 50 percent off on laptops, No Cost EMI for up to 24 months and up to Rs. 25,000 off on exchange.
title: Best AI Laptops Around Rs. 1 Lakh on Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026

description: Vivo X500 Ultra could be launched in select global markets as the smartphone has been spotted in an IMEI listing with model numbers V2660 and J2613. The two new listings suggest that the smartphone could launch the Vivo X500 Ultra in select global markets, including Turkiye and Brazil. However, the company has yet to confirm. Earlier reports suggested that the phone might not debut outside China. Apart from Vivo, Oppo was also reported not to launch the Oppo Find X10 Ultra model in global markets as a result of rising manufacturing costs driven by the ongoing DRAM and NAND chip shortage and supply chain disruptions.
title: Vivo X500 Ultra Global Launch Seems Likely as Phone Appears in IMEI Database; Could Get a Camera Downgrade

description: Ethereum developers have delayed the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet while investigating risks linked to proposed gas accounting changes. Security firm ChainSecurity found that EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 could alter how contracts handle failed operations and storage creation. Although the researchers demonstrated the potential issues, they have not publicly identified a production protocol affected by the vulnerability.
title: Ethereum Postpones Glamsterdam Testing as Developers Warn of Contract Risks

description: Spotify has confirmed that it is strengthening verification methods for its Premium Family Plan. The company recently started a QR code-based process to check whether members live at the same address as the plan manager. Users have seven days after receiving a notification to complete the verification. Members who miss the deadline can not join another Family or Duo plan for 12 months.
title: Spotify Says Family Plan Verification Will Continue as It Tightens Account-Sharing Rules

description: OnePlus has revealed more details about its upcoming Buds Clip, including their audio hardware, connectivity features and battery life. The open-ear earbuds feature 11mm and 9mm dynamic drivers, support LHDC 5.0 audio and include a 10-band equaliser. They also offer Bluetooth 6.1, dual-device connectivity and AI-assisted calling features. OnePlus claims up to 36 hours of playback with the charging case. The earbuds carry an IP55 rating and will come in Pearl White, Pebble Grey and Twilight Rose colour options.
title: OnePlus Buds Clip Features, Colours Revealed Ahead of Expected Global Launch

description: Canva has introduced Craft, an image generation model designed to create both realistic images and design-focused visuals. Developed by Canva Research, it uses a two-stage process to plan image composition before rendering the final result. The model was trained on millions of templates from Canva's content library and supports editable outputs through Magic Layers. It also ranked first in the People and Portraits and Landscapes and Nature categories on DesignArena. Canva is developing faster, lower-cost versions called Craft-fast and Craft-ultrafast.
title: Canva Craft Image Generator Now Available Globally With Support for 55 Languages, 30 Aspect Ratios

description: Airtel on Friday announced a partnership with YouTube to bring YouTube Premium benefits to its prepaid customers in India. The offering is available through an affordable entertainment top-up. The YouTube Premium subscription provides ad-free video viewing, in addition to YouTube Music Premium access and other features. The offer is valid for 28 days, after which Airtel prepaid subscribers can renew the top-up to continue accessing the YouTube Premium benefits.
title: Airtel Brings YouTube Premium to Prepaid Customers With New OTT Bundle: How to Claim It

description: JPMorgan Asset Management has made two tokenised money market funds, MONY and JLTXX, available to eligible US investors on Solana through its Morgan Money platform. Investors can subscribe to and redeem fund tokens, which are deposited into their blockchain wallets. MONY invests in US Treasury bonds and Treasury-backed repurchase agreements, while its structure includes investor onboarding checks and an off-chain shareholder ledger.
title: JPMorgan Introduces Two Solana-Based Tokenised Funds for US Investors

description: OpenAI has announced that the Decisions API is now generally available for developers. They can use the GPT-6 Luna-powered Decisions API to help their AI agents and apps make small and recurring decisions, like categorising and arranging information, routing requests, and selecting the next action. The AI giant claims that the Decisions API can make “near real-time decisions” using images, text, and structured inputs up to 10x faster than the GPT‑6 Luna AI model via the Responses API. Moreover, OpenAI claims that developers can pass native JSON inputs and include images in question instructions, while also being able to ask up to 400 questions per request with the Decisions API.
title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Luna-Powered Decisions API Is Now Generally Available for Developers With Native GPT-Live Integration: Price, Capabilities

description: As per the Safety Korea listings, the batteries for the purported Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra and Galaxy S27 Pro carry model numbers EB-BS958DBY and EB-BS957CBY, respectively. The listings are linked to certification numbers YU10899-26034 and YU10899-26036. Both battery units are reportedly manufactured by Zhuhai CosMX Power Jinwan Subsidiary in China. The listing also includes images of the battery units.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra, Galaxy S27 Pro Batteries Listed on Safety Korea With Images

description: Apple is reportedly testing the iPhone Duo 2 with Face ID technology built into its outer display, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. The company may also add the customisable Action button and a dedicated telephoto camera, neither of which features on the current foldable. Gurman has also suggested that future generations could receive a larger inner display, potentially measuring between 8.5 and 9 inches. Apple has not confirmed these developments, and some upgrades may arrive on later models instead.
title: Apple Reportedly Testing iPhone Duo 2 Prototype With Under-Display Face ID, Action Button: Mark Gurman

description: The OnePlus Ace 7 series is set to launch in China soon as the latest performance-focused lineup from the brand. The upcoming lineup will comprise two models — OnePlus Ace 7 and OnePlus Ace 7 Pro, both of which are confirmed to feature dedicated hardware for thermal management during extended gaming sessions. Ahead of their anticipated debut, the brand has offered the first look at the phones' designs and colour options.
title: OnePlus Ace 7, OnePlus Ace 7 Pro Design and Colour Options Revealed Ahead of China Launch

description: YouTube is introducing a major update to its Home page on mobile and desktop. The latest update allows users to create custom feeds using natural language prompts. YouTube is also revamping the top bar on its mobile app home page. The new custom feeds feature is currently rolling out on mobile and desktop in English to US-based, signed-in viewers. It is available for users aged 13 and older who have search history enabled. YouTube will soon expand the feature to more users and regions.
title: YouTube Updates Home Feed With Custom Recommendations and Dedicated Content Feeds

description: Oppo has released a new power bank in India called the 22.5W Power Bank 10000 mAh. As its name suggests, it offers a 10,000mAh battery and up to 22.5W output. It also includes a built-in USB-C cable and two USB ports.
title: Oppo 22.5W 10,000mAh Power Bank With USB-C Cable Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: Google announced new features for Fitbit Air and the Google Health app on Thursday. As per the Mountain View-based tech giant, the additions are aimed at helping users make sense of their activity and wellness data with less manual effort. The company is bringing expanded automatic workout detection and new tools to monitor longer-term health trends. Additionally, users will also be able to experience improvements to its AI-powered Health Coach in the Google Health app.
title: Google Adds Health Guardian Features to Fitbit Air, Expands Workout Detection to 100 Activities

description: A tipster has shared details about the expected Indian lineup of the Oppo Reno 17 series, claiming that only the Reno 17 and Reno 17c will launch in the country. The standard model is tipped to use a Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset, while the Reno 17c could feature a Dimensity 7300 SoC. The Reno 17 Pro is also tipped to feature a 200-megapixel main camera, a Dimensity 8550 chipset, a 7,000mAh battery and 80W charging.
title: Oppo Reno 17 Series India Launch Timeline, Chipsets Tipped

description: Samsung Galaxy Fit 4 design and colour options have been spotted in leaked computer-aided design (CAD) renders. The fitness tracker appears in black, white, and light blue colour options. In terms of design, the wearable could be similar to the Samsung Galaxy Fit 3. It might feature a vertically elongated rectangular display. A physical button appears on the right side of the Samsung Galaxy Fit 4, along with a small hole-punch. It might sport relatively thin bezels around its flat display. Further, the Samsung Galaxy Fit 4 could ship with an interchangeable silicone strap. The image also shows the wearable with a new watch face, showing the time, heart rate, and date.
title: Samsung Galaxy Fit 4 Design, Colour Options Spotted in Leaked Renders Ahead of Launch

description: EA shut down BioWare and cancelled the next Mass Effect title this week. Now a trailer for the cancelled game, Mass Effect: Universe, has leaked online. The trailer shows a glimpse of the game, including returning characters, combat abilities, and more. The trailer includes in-engine footage and pre-production assets.
title: Trailer for Cancelled Mass Effect Game Leaks Online After EA Shuts Down BioWare

description: Samsung W27, a China-exclusive book-style foldable, has been spotted in leaked renders, revealing its design. The China-exclusive foldable is shown to sport a more premium-looking colour scheme than the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra. It might ship with a flat rear panel finished in the Royal Blue shade. Meanwhile, the vertical pill-shaped rear camera module appears in the gold shade. An additional insignia appears at the bottom of the panel, finished in the same colour as the camera island. Apart from this, the Samsung W27 foldable appears with the same flat metal frame as the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra. However, the mid-frame appears to be finished in a shade of gold, adding to the overall premium look of the book-style foldable. The power button and volume controls could be placed on the right side of the phone, similar to the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra.
title: Samsung W27 Design Leaked With Royal Blue Finish, Gold Camera Module Ahead of China Launch

description: The iPhone Duo has finally gone on sale in India and the global markets. It was introduced in September as Apple’s first foldable iPhone. As such, it brings a massive inner display that is claimed to be 50 percent larger than the iPhone 18 Pro Max, albeit at a significantly high price point. With the handset now reaching customers, an early teardown of the iPhone Duo has surfaced. It offers a closer look at the hardware inside and shows what happens when that matte, nano-textured cover layer on the inner screen is removed.
title: iPhone Duo Teardown Reveals How Its Matte Film Hides the Inner Display Crease

description: According to data from market research firm Circana, Marvel’s Wolverine delivered the highest monthly dollar sales for a Sony-published title since Helldivers 2 in February 2024. The seuperhero title debuted as the best-selling game in the US in September. However, the PS5 exclusive is yet to crack the top 10 best-selling games in the US for the year so far. That list is led by NBA 2K27, followed by Resident Evil Requiem and 007 First Light.
title: Marvel's Wolverine Was the Best-Selling Game in the US in September

description: Bitcoin briefly fell to $81,200 as technology stocks declined, triggering nearly $455 million in leveraged liquidations. Despite the correction, US spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted more than $524 million on Wednesday, while traders monitor key support levels and the Federal Reserve’s upcoming policy decision.
title: Bitcoin Falls Below $82,000 as Tech Sell-Off Triggers $455 Million in Liquidations

description: iQOO Neo 12 is now available for pre-order in China, the company announced on Friday. The microsite confirms that the upcoming smartphone will be equipped with a 9,000mAh Blue Ocean Battery with the fifth-generation Silicon Anode Technology and an energy density of up to 916Wh/L. The handset will also feature Global Direct Drive Power Supply 2.0. The iQOO Neo 12 will also debut with support for 100W wired fast charging. The handset is claimed to provide up to 11.6 hours of Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) gaming or up to 29.9 hours of short-form video playback on a single charge. The iQOO Neo 12 is confirmed to sport the industry’s first 2K resolution display that refreshes at up to 185Hz with the fourth-generation pTSF technology.
title: iQOO Neo 12 Specifications Revealed Ahead of Launch, Pre-Orders Open in China

description: Apple’s iPhone Duo has finally gone on sale globally. The iPhone Duo will be available in limited quantities in store, mainly for those who pre-ordered the unit in advance and received an in-store pickup date on launch day. Whether you are receiving your iPhone Duo today or a few months from now, here is the list of apps that will support the Duo out of the box.
title: iPhone Duo App Support Revealed: List of Apps Optimised for Apple’s First Foldable

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra users are reportedly facing a bug after installing the One UI 9 update based on Android 17. The problem appears to be linked to the WebView component. User reports on social media platforms and Samsung's community forum suggest that the issue reportedly prevents affected users from completing the Samsung account sign-in process. Samsung has acknowledged the issue and suggested a few temporary workarounds.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Users Report Setup Screen Freeze After One UI 9 Update

description: Insta360 Mic has been launched globally. The new microphone is Insta360's first model to feature a customisable E-Ink display. It has a microSD card slot for expandable storage. The wireless microphone supports 32-bit float internal recording, AI noise cancellation, automatic gain control, and voice tone presets. It supports Bluetooth Direct Connect with select Insta360 cameras, including X6, X5, Luna Ultra, Luna Pro, GO Ultra, and Ace Pro 2. The microphone offers up to 13 hours of battery life per transmitter
title: Insta360 Mic Wireless Microphone Launched With Customisable E-Ink Display: Price, Features

description: MacBook Pro with an OLED display will be launched at a notably higher price than the current generation model, according to a report. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with an OLED screen will reportedly be launched at a starting price between $2,799 (roughly Rs. 2,66,000) and $2,999 (about Rs. 2,85,000). According to the report, the revised pricing is based on a Bill of Materials (BOM) analysis, and the final retail pricing could be different. Naranjo reportedly called the price jump an “Apple Tax”. The price jump is said to help Apple maintain a healthy profit on the MacBook Pro models, while also covering the laptop’s upgrade to an advanced tandem OLED panel, along with the ongoing AI-driven NAND and DRAM price hikes.
title: Apple’s First MacBook Pro With OLED Display to Launch at a Notably Higher Price Than the Current Generation: Report

description: Bose has purchased Skullcandy from a fund managed by Mill Road Capital Management, adding the audio brand to its Premium Consumer Audio business. Skullcandy will retain its identity and headquarters in Park City, Utah, while gaining access to Bose's technology, resources and distribution network. The acquisition builds on an existing collaboration that has brought Bose audio technology to Skullcandy products, including the Method 360 ANC earbuds and Crusher 1080 ANC headphones. The companies have not revealed the financial terms of the deal.
title: Bose Takes Over Skullcandy, Plans to Invest in Brand’s Growth

description: The Department of Telecommunications (DoT) has directed messaging and communication apps to comply with SIM-binding rules from January 1, 2027. The compliance directive mandates that such apps implement a SIM-based login verification process in an attempt to keep user accounts linked to the active SIM cards associated with their registered Indian mobile numbers. DoT says the move is aimed at curbing fraud and safeguarding the digital ecosystem. The rules could change how users access services such as WhatsApp, Telegram and Signal on their devices.
title: DoT’s SIM Binding Rules Set to Take Effect Beginning January 1 to Curb Cyber Fraud: Here’s What Changes

description: The iPhone Duo is finally available for purchase in India. Apple’s first foldable iPhone was launched at the ‘Surprise and Shine' event in September alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. But while both non-foldable models went on sale a week after their unveiling, the iPhone Duo remained unavailable for purchase. The Cupertino-based tech giant opened pre-orders for the foldable handset last week, and its general sale is all set to begin today.
title: iPhone Duo Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers and Specifications
